The Department module is used to manage the details of different departments within the library. This includes information about the department name, code, head, location, contact details, and number of employees.

Fields and Descriptions

Department Name:

  • Description: The name of the department within the library.
  • Usage: Enter the full name of the department.
  • Example: "Acquisitions Department"
  • Validation: Must be a valid string and not duplicated within the library system.

Department Code:

  • Description: A unique code assigned to the department for identification purposes.
  • Usage: Enter a unique code for the department.
  • Example: "ACQ"
  • Validation: Must be a unique identifier and adhere to any predefined format.

Head of Department:

  • Description: The name of the person who is the head or manager of the department.
  • Usage: Enter the full name of the head of the department.
  • Example: "Jane Doe"
  • Validation: Must be a valid name string.

Location:

  • Description: The physical location or office where the department is situated within the library.
  • Usage: Enter the location details of the department.
  • Example: "Second Floor, East Wing"
  • Validation: Must be a valid string representing the department's location.

Phone:

  • Description: The contact phone number for the department.
  • Usage: Enter the phone number where the department can be reached.
  • Example: "+1-555-1234"
  • Validation: Must be a valid phone number format.

Email:

  • Description: The email address for the department.
  • Usage: Enter the department's contact email address.
  • Example: "acquisitions@library.org"
  • Validation: Must be a valid email address format.

Number of Employees:

  • Description: The total number of employees working in the department.
  • Usage: Enter the count of employees within the department.
  • Example: "10"
  • Validation: Must be a positive integer.
